purpose: Verify the F4 names/numbers/keys we intend to introduce do not collide with existing identifiers.

adr.rationale: F4 is reuse/extraction under existing doctrine (ADR-0040 teach-before-test, ADR-0044 reveal, ADR-0021 eval graph, ADR-0052/0053 bilingual). No new architectural decision is forced. If the reveal-extraction is judged decision-worthy at build time, allocate ADR-0054 then; spec does not pre-spend it.

reveal.why (header for the why line, e.g. 'Why:' / 'Pourquoi :')

newI18nKeys.parity: Each new key MUST carry FR+EN (structural in Message type).

verdict: No blocking collisions. Component name free, AP-TEACH namespace free, ADR not over-allocated, i18n keys free and parity-guarded.
